mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly rise in GDP (GDPC1) signals robust demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day returns in expanding economies are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising monthly employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strong labor market, predicting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year window, or 60-day returns in stable labor markets are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in FEDFUNDS above 4% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to anticipated tightening.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns despite FEDFUNDS crossing above 4%, or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 1-month period.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL crossing above 2.0 in the next month signals inflation concerns, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the following 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL crosses above 2.0, or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous quarterly rise in GDP (GDPC1) and decline in FEDFUNDS signals accommodative monetary policy and robust demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are not significantly positive when both GDPC1 rises and FEDFUNDS falls, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in industrial production (INDPRO) and decline in FEDFUNDS indicates easing monetary policy and strong supply, predicting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are not significantly positive when both INDPRO rises and FEDFUNDS falls, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-week period.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained decline in FEDFUNDS predicts stronger positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to accommodative policy.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns in late-cycle expansions are not significantly higher than baseline when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-recession recovery regime (UNRATE > 6%), a decline in UNRATE below 5.5% signals improving labor market conditions, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are not significantly positive when UNRATE falls below 5.5% in post-recession regimes, or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 2-year window.
